2610.07885.title: Label-Efficient Deep Learning for ECG Delineation: A Multi-Dataset Benchmark against Widely Used Delineation Tools
2610.07885.paper_summary: Electrocardiogram (ECG) delineation, the identification of waveform boundaries, is a foundational step that translates raw ECG signals into clinically interpretable measurements. Deep learning has advanced this task but remains dependent on costly expert annotations. Label-efficient strategies such as self-supervised pretraining and semi-supervised learning are expected to ease this burden, yet it remains unclear whether they yield reliable delineation and whether the deep models they produce outperform the delineation tools used in practice. We address this in two stages. First, comparing self-supervised objectives with supervised or semi-supervised fine-tuning across one internal and four external datasets, we find that pretraining helps but the objective matters, and that the value of semi-supervised fine-tuning depends on the pretraining objective. Second, we benchmark the selected deep learning model against widely used open-source (NeuroKit2, Prominence, ECGdeli) and commercial (CalECG) tools using three complementary metrics. The model ranks best on every metric and dataset, outperforming the strongest tool by a clear margin on the rhythm-diverse set (mIoU 71.3 vs. 54.8%; averaged point-wise sensitivity 92.6 vs. 76.4%), and degrades the least from sinus to arrhythmia. A rhythm-stratified and point-wise analysis further characterizes the distinctive behavior of each tool, yielding practical guidance for tool selection. These results provide systematic, multi-dataset evidence that self-supervised pretraining is effective for ECG delineation and enables a label-efficiently trained deep learning model to outperform widely used delineation tools by leveraging abundant unlabeled data. This supports adopting such models in diverse, real-world clinical settings.
2610.07885.paper_summary_zh: 心電圖（ECG）輪廓描繪，即波形邊界的識別，是將原始ECG信號轉換為臨床可解釋測量的基礎步驟。深度學習已經推進了這項任務，但仍然依賴於昂貴的專家標註。預期標籤高效策略，如自監督預訓練和半監督學習，能夠減輕這一負擔，但仍不清楚它們是否能產生可靠的輪廓描繪，以及它們所生成的深度模型是否優於實際使用的輪廓描繪工具。我們將此問題分為兩個階段來解決。首先，通過在一個內部數據集和四個外部數據集上比較自監督目標與監督或半監督微調，我們發現預訓練有幫助，但目標很重要，且半監督微調的價值取決於預訓練目標。其次，我們使用三個互補的指標，將所選的深度學習模型與廣泛使用的開源（NeuroKit2、Prominence、ECGdeli）和商業（CalECG）工具進行基準測試。該模型在每個指標和數據集上均排名最佳，在節律多樣的數據集上明顯超越最強工具（mIoU 71.3 vs. 54.8%；平均逐點靈敏度 92.6 vs. 76.4%），並且從竇性心律到心律不整的降級最小。對節律分層和逐點分析進一步描述了每個工具的獨特行為，為工具選擇提供了實用指導。這些結果提供了系統的多數據集證據，表明自監督預訓練對ECG輪廓描繪是有效的，並使得標籤高效訓練的深度學習模型能夠通過利用豐富的未標記數據超越廣泛使用的輪廓描繪工具。這支持在多樣的現實臨床環境中採用這類模型。
